links.comparator_used: Direct prompting (no reasoning) on the same models
links.outcome: Accuracy on structured EHR table tasks (numerical answers)
links.effect: CoT prompting moderately improved performance versus uniformly low direct-prompting accuracy, particularly for logical filtering; no numeric values reported in the abstract
links.tradeoff: CoT performance degraded significantly as table size increased, with limited accuracy and poor scalability
links.quote: CoT prompting moderately improved performance, particularly for logical filtering, but results degraded significantly as table size increased.

links.comparator_used: Direct prompting and chain-of-thought prompting, where the LLM answers directly in text
links.outcome: Accuracy on structured EHR table tasks and valid JSON output formatting
links.effect: Tool-based strategy (LLM-generated Python code, executed to retrieve answers) substantially improved accuracy over direct and CoT prompting; no numeric values reported in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Smaller models and distilled reasoning variants had more frequent formatting and execution errors
links.quote: The tool-based strategy substantially improved accuracy.

links.comparator_used: Direct prompting and chain-of-thought prompting, where the LLM computes answers directly from the table text
links.outcome: Accuracy on structured EHR table tasks and valid output formatting
links.effect: Tool-based prompting, where models generated and executed Python code, achieved higher accuracy and valid output formatting than direct and CoT prompting; no numeric values reported in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Smaller models and distilled reasoning variants had more frequent formatting and execution errors
links.quote: Tool-based prompting, where models generated and executed Python code, achieved higher accuracy and valid output formatting.

design_hint: tool-enabled code generation vs direct/CoT prompting
